title.value: DiffPack: A Torsional Diffusion Model for Autoregressive Protein Side-Chain Packing
title.justification: The title clearly states the focus on protein side-chain packing using a torsional diffusion model.
title.quote: DiffPack: A Torsional Diffusion Model for Autoregressive Protein Side-Chain Packing

extractions.description: The paper presents DiffPack, a torsional diffusion model designed for predicting the conformation of protein side-chains based on torsional angles. It introduces an autoregressive approach to generate these torsional angles, improving accuracy and computational efficiency compared to previous models. The model is evaluated against benchmarks CASP13 and CASP14, demonstrating significant improvements in accuracy of angle predictions. Additionally, it enhances the side-chain predictions of the AlphaFold2 model.

primary_category.justification: The paper is centered around protein structure prediction, which does not directly relate to any predefined eco-responsible category such as climate change mitigation or natural systems protection.
primary_category.quote: Proteins play a critical role in carrying out biological functions, and their 3D structures are essential in determining their functions. Accurately predicting the conformation of protein side-chains given their backbones is important for applications in protein structure prediction, design and protein-protein interactions.
